message.content: {"hts_code": "6702.10.2000", "reason": "A decorative Halloween tree made of PVC plastic branches is artificial foliage of plastics, and because it is a Halloween (not Christmas) article it is excluded from heading 9505, so it is classified in subheading 6702.10.20, HTSUS."}
message.reasoning: Halloween decorative tree — artificial tree of plastics? Heading 6702 covers artificial foliage/Christmas trees of plastics. Halloween tree — is it a Christmas tree? Rulings have classified Halloween trees under 6702.10.2000? Actually 6702.10 covers artificial flowers, foliage and fruit of plastics. Christmas tree subheading 9505.10 applies to Christmas articles. A Halloween tree is not a Christmas article, so 6702.10.2000 (foliage of plastics). Check: 6702.10.2000 "Of plastics" — actually 6702.10.2000 is "Flowers, foliage and fruit, and parts thereof". There are subheadings: 6702.10.1000 (flowers... of plastics), 6702.10.2000 (foliage...). Yes, 6702.10.2000.
